- **Lewis & Clark College — San Diego contact:** The California territory table assigns **San Diego County to Qwadere “Q” Lovell**. His actual Lewis & Clark profile lists: **Senior Assistant Dean of Admissions, Southern California**; **qlovell@lclark.edu**; **503-713-1203**; office: **Frank Manor House**; address: **615 S. Palatine Hill Road, Portland, OR 97219**. [Contact profile](https://college.lclark.edu/live/profiles/13789-qwadere-q-lovell) | [California county-assignment table](https://college.lclark.edu/offices/admissions/get_to_know_us/staff/counties/california/). Both are left open; the latter visibly shows the county-by-counselor assignment, including San Diego.

- **Hunter College Silberman MSW — Fall deadline:** On Silberman’s official [Deadlines page](https://sssw.hunter.cuny.edu/admissions/deadlines/), the posted **Fall** deadline for the MSW programs shown (Two-Year Full-Time, Bank Street dual degree, Advanced Standing, and One-Year Residency) is **March 1**; **supporting documents: March 15**. This is the live admissions page I checked (the site labels the cycle “FALL,” rather than printing a separate year next to the date).

- **Indiana University Kokomo — graduate-program page:** The official [Graduate Programs page](https://kokomo.iu.edu/graduate-programs/index.html) says its offerings span **master’s degrees, graduate certificates, and postbaccalaureate work**; its “Explore” section specifically displays **Master’s Degrees** and **Graduate Certificates**. The page is open in its own tab as requested.

- **UCSF recruiting glioblastoma studies in Northern California:**
  1. **Anti-EGFRvIII synNotch Receptor Induced Anti-EphA2/IL-13Ralpha2 CAR (E-SYNC) T Cells** (NCT06186401) — **Status: accepting new patients**; **UCSF, San Francisco, CA 94143**. It is a Phase 1 study for EGFRvIII-positive glioblastoma. [Actual UCSF trial page](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/trial/NCT06186401) is open.
  2. **DOC1021 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)** (NCT06805305) — **Status: accepting new patients**; **UCSF, San Francisco, CA 94143** (also lists City of Hope in Duarte, CA). It is a Phase 2 study. [Actual UCSF trial page](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/trial/NCT06805305) is open.

- **Oral Roberts University student-life contact:** ORU’s official [“Meet the Team” page](https://oru.edu/life-at-oru/student-life/meet-the-team.php) lists **Bethany Smith, Assistant Director of Student Association** — **besmith@oru.edu**, **918-495-6664**. I used ORU’s own student-life page, not a directory aggregator. (The current page does not use the exact title “Student Activities Director.”) It remains open.

- **EDF Energy graduate programme / pay progression:** EDF’s official graduate/placement brochure is open [here](https://www.edfenergy.com/sites/default/files/graduate_and_placement_brochure_2023_2024.pdf). Its exact wording is: **“Starting salary is £35,000. You’ll receive annual increases, plus annual bonus, relocation allowances and other flexible benefits.”** Thus, it promises **annual increases**; it does not use the specific phrase “salary review.”

Key evidence tabs left open: Lewis & Clark’s Qwadere Lovell profile and California territory table; IU Kokomo graduate-program page; both individual UCSF trial pages; ORU team page; and EDF’s official brochure.
